_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil statistics (only 7% of windows break ±2) plus flat momentum/F&G cluster make HOLD the skilled default; Complacency is the sole +1 rung allowed from Anxiety.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly HOLD/Complacency; narrative supplies no forward phase call, only commodity flow description
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC 30d stays near flat and Fear & Greed holds 45-55 without range break
next_move.invalidated_if: Price leaves the coil with F&G breaking below 40 or above 60, or spot ETF flows reverse hard off extremes
